services.desc: Create unforgettable memories on the water. Our premium fleet of pontoons is perfect for family outings, celebrations, or a relaxing day in the sun. Our luxury tri-toons have a captain's seat, plush seating, a Bimini top for partial shade, radio and anchor. This boat also has a co-captain's seat. Each boat is equipped with all safety equipment, including life jackets. Animals and open flame are prohibited. Full Day rentals run 9am to 5pm.
